name: Literate Avin
comment: A .lavin file is a Markdown document whose lines indented four columns are an Avin program. The rules are the compiler's: a line indented four columns is program text, a fenced block is an illustration however it is indented, and an indented line under a list item belongs to the item. Every line a rule here does not claim is prose, set with Markdown's inline grammar.

program.comment: A run of lines indented four columns, with blank lines between them, is the program. It ends at a line of prose: one with content less than four columns in.
program.name: meta.embedded.block.avin

fence-avin.comment: A fenced illustration marked avin is not compiled, and is coloured as Avin.
fence-avin.name: markup.fenced_code.block.markdown

fence.comment: Any other fenced block is an illustration, set as it is written.
fence.name: markup.fenced_code.block.markdown

list.comment: A list item runs to the first line with content no further in than its marker, so a blank line does not end it, and what is indented under it is prose.
list.name: markup.list.markdown
